description: Zeke Draker is the first direct descendant of the legendary Dragon Slayer family to fail awakening. Because he possesses the talent of a healer instead of a swordsman, he is cast out by his family. After struggling desperately to become stronger, Zeke meets a tragic end. At the moment of his death, the soul of an Elder Dragon is engraved upon his will and an irreversible power awakens. He then returns twenty years into the past, back to the Dragon Slayer family that abandoned him. Armed with immortal power, Zeke begins a new life determined to become a Dragon Slayer in a class of his own.
author: Gon / Hectopascal
